claim_verdicts.evidence: git show stage-1:DonHang.Domain/OrderService.cs lines 29-38: FindAsync ?? throw KeyNotFoundException; `order.Status = "cancelled"; await repository.SaveChangesAsync(); notifier.Send(order.Id, "order cancelled"); return order;`. No read of order.Status, so the r3 split sentence (a `paid` order is cancelled the same way; story line 5 is about orders "chưa thanh toán") holds. Block matches source.

OrderServiceTests.cs@stage-1 has exactly two cancel tests (lines 46, 58): NewOrder seeds Status="new" and asserts "cancelled"; UnknownOrder asserts KeyNotFoundException for id 999. Neither reads FakeNotifier.Sent; no test seeds "shipped". Lines 65-67 comment: "No test here cancels a `shipped` order. The suite is green". `dotnet test DonHang.Tests` at stage-1 (r1): Passed 5, Failed 0. Block matches tools/extract-code (only an em-dash encoding artifact in the pipe).

story-example.md@stage-1 line 5: "hủy đơn hàng chưa thanh toán của mình"; AC3: "Khi đơn ở trạng thái `paid`, `shipped` hoặc `cancelled`, nút \"Hủy đơn\" không hiện."; AC4: "trả về 403 và không thay đổi gì"; AC5: "lần thứ hai trả về 409"; DoD: "Có test tự động cho mọi tiêu chí chấp nhận ở trên."

OrderServiceTests.cs@stage-1 contains 5 tests: three PlaceOrderAsync, CancelOrderAsync_NewOrder_SetsStatusCancelled, CancelOrderAsync_UnknownOrder_Throws. None seeds paid/shipped/cancelled, none involves another customer (403) or a second cancel (409). It is the only service test file under DonHang.Tests (git ls-tree stage-1), so the r2 sentence "none of them has a service test" also holds; CancelOrderAsync(int) takes no customer id.

Review practice stated by the outline itself (track.yaml outline items 1-3, near-verbatim); no versioned official doc governs it and the lesson hedges item 3 ("may be passing"). Treated as the lesson's method, not a factual claim.

Ledger now kind `behavior`, needs_verification true (r2 fix applied). Re-checked FakeOrderRepository@stage-1: `Seed(Order order) => orders[order.Id] = order;`, `FindAsync(int id) => Task.FromResult(orders.GetValueOrDefault(id));` (same object back), `SaveChangesAsync() => Task.CompletedTask`. A service that never touches Status returns the seeded object still "cancelled", so Assert.Equal("cancelled", order.Status) passes. Lesson §4 text unchanged and matches.

OrderServiceTests.cs@stage-1: every one of the 5 tests constructs its own fakes: lines 14-15 and 26-27 (`new FakeOrderRepository()`, `new FakeNotifier()`), line 40 and 60 (`new OrderService(new FakeOrderRepository(), new FakeNotifier())`), lines 48 and 50. The class has no instance fields; `OneItem` is a static expression-bodied property returning a new OrderItem per access.
